name: The Mirror Eater
source:
A QUIET, FLORAL OCCUPATION

A wildfire raging across the southern steppe draws ever-nearer as a troubled trio faces an uncertain future in their dying hometown of Tasusuni.

[From [url=https://projectulysses.itch.io/the-mirror-eater]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一份與花為伴的寧靜差事

野火橫掃南方草原，步步逼近。故鄉塔蘇蘇尼日漸衰敗，三個各懷心事的人在這裡共同面對未卜的將來。
